edges.reason: mint delegates to the internal _mint routine.
_user is forwarded into _mint as the token recipient.
_tokenId flows into _mint and keys MintingInfo.
_tier flows into _mint and is stored in MintingInfo.
_rate flows into _mint and drives mintingRate updates.
_mint writes mintingInfo[_tokenId].
_mint increments mintingRate for the recipient.
_mint performs an external call to YieldToken.updateUserTimeOnMint after state changes.
transferFrom calls the untrusted YieldToken.updateReward external hook.
safeTransferFrom calls the untrusted YieldToken.updateReward external hook.
transferFrom decrements mintingRate[from] by the token rate.
transferFrom increments mintingRate[to] by the token rate.
transferFrom mutates the mintingRate mapping.
safeTransferFrom mutates the mintingRate mapping.
The local _mintingRate is subtracted from mintingRate[from].
The local _mintingRate is added to mintingRate[to].
from indexes the mintingRate balance that is decremented.
to indexes the mintingRate balance that is incremented.
getReward calls the untrusted YieldToken.getReward payout external function.
getReward calls YieldToken.updateReward before paying out.
Local user (msg.sender) is passed to YieldToken.getReward.
msg.sender determines who receives the reward in getReward.
msg.sender is checked by the isAllowAddress modifier against SaleContract.
SaleContract address is the required caller in the isAllowAddress gate.
msg.sender is burned from and validated as owner in changeCustomName.
msg.sender is burned from and validated as owner in changeBio.
changeCustomName performs an external YieldToken.burn call before finalizing state.
changeBio performs an external YieldToken.burn call before finalizing state.
setTokenAddress overwrites the YieldToken reference.
setSalesAddress overwrites the SaleContract reference.
setCollectionIndex overwrites collectionIndex.
msg.sender is the onlyOwner caller authorized for upgrades.
tokenURI branches on the revealed flag set by setRevealed.
The transfer hook gates all mintingRate mutations via whenNotPaused.
collectionIndex is passed into the YieldToken accounting call.
collectionIndex is passed into the YieldToken reward payout call.

normalization_plan.reason: _user parameter only serves the _mint call and carries no independent state.
_tokenId parameter only keys the MintingInfo write inside _mint.
_tier parameter is stored directly into mintingInfo by _mint.
_rate parameter drives the mintingRate update inside _mint.
Local _mintingRate is the operand of the mintingRate decrement operation.
Parameter from is only the mapping index for the mintingRate decrement.
Parameter to is only the mapping index for the mintingRate increment.
Parameter tokenId selects the token handled by transferFrom.
Local user is just msg.sender forwarded into the reward payout call.
_tokenId only identifies the token modified by changeCustomName.
_newName is the value consumed by the name-change logic.
_tokenId only identifies the token modified by changeBio.
_newBio is the value consumed by the bio-change logic.
_newTokenAddress is directly assigned to the YieldToken state variable.
_newSalesAddress is directly assigned to the SaleContract state variable.
newBaseURI is directly assigned to the baseURI state variable.
_revealed is directly assigned to the revealed state variable.
